build_note: Source-built from the pinned sdist with maturin 1.16.0 (--locked) and rustc 1.99.1 -C instrument-coverage, codegen-units=1, LTO off, release debug info and no stripping (python_release profile overrides). The sdist Cargo.lock also lists crates of workspace members the sdist does not ship; cargo prunes them on the first fetch and the image checks that the pruned lock is a strict subset of the shipped one. The official wheels compile the same crates with optimisation.
dependencies_note: No Python runtime dependencies. Rust crates polyglot-sql 0.14.1 (in the sdist), pyo3 0.28.2 and pythonize 0.28 are compiled in from the sdist Cargo.lock. The fuzz entry point is an external one-file Python bridge, not Atheris.
parser_family: polyglot-sql (Rust tokenizer and recursive-descent parser modelled on sqlglot), the same polyglot-sql 0.14.1 crate source as the Rust polyglot-sql path; the package's own pyo3 binding (crates/polyglot-sql-python) wraps the parsed Expression tree as Python Expression objects
api: polyglot_sql.parse(local SQL text decoded from UTF-8 bytes, dialect="generic") -> list of polyglot_sql Expression objects; the harness reads Select and Insert argument records and walks Table, Function, typed aggregate (Count, Sum) and Literal nodes with Expression.walk()
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source-range coverage of the source-built polyglot-sql extension: the polyglot-sql 0.14.1 parser crate sources (the crates/polyglot-sql-python pyo3 binding is required to execute and reported separately)
scope: One SQL statement from local text via polyglot_sql.parse with the generic dialect; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Transpile, generate, format, validate, lineage, other dialects and the optimised wheel build are untested.
